list_note: Names, descriptions and grades are the official ones as published on PlayStation Network, cross-checked on Exophase and PSNProfiles on 18 November 2026. Guides are written for this entry in our own words; each cites its sources.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops on its own. There is no online trophy and no DLC requirement, so one playthrough plus free-roam cleanup is enough. PowerPyx rates the whole run 4/10 difficulty at about 200 hours.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Automatic. Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1 — the first mission of the story. You cannot miss it.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Automatic. Finish Chapter 1; it pops when the first mission of Chapter 2 begins (What's in the Bag?).

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Automatic. Finish Chapter 2; it pops when the first mission of Chapter 3 begins (Welcome to Vice City).

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Automatic. Finish Chapter 3; it pops after the first two missions of Chapter 4 (Ocean Beach and Another Life).

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Automatic. Finish Chapter 4; it pops after the chapter's final mission (Starting From Zero).

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Automatic. Finish the story's final mission. It is the only gold story trophy — the other gold is the 100% completion trophy, A Long Road.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Automatic. Finish the Chapter 2 mission Breakfast Run.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Automatic. Finish the Chapter 3 mission The Cartel Heist.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Automatic. Finish the Chapter 4 mission Child's Play.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Automatic. Finish the Chapter 4 mission Headliners.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Automatic. Finish the Chapter 4 mission VCIA Takedown.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Automatic. Finish the Chapter 5 mission Operation Savage Glory.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy. After the story, open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion and finish the checklist — but it is lenient, closer to 60% true completion. You need any 100 optional missions, 70 of 80 challenges, 200 of 277 base vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, 300 stunts, and all robberies, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests. Nothing toward it is missable, and progress made during the story already counts.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts: 130 Stunt Jumps, 202 Under the Bridges, 40 Knife Flights and 25 Base Jumps. Mix the categories — Under the Bridges are the quickest. For 100% you need 300, so this pops on the way. Track progress in Progress > Activities > Stunts, and find them on the map under Exploration > Stunt Spots.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, a video game, a race (car race, race challenge or Top Fun drone race), and a stunt. Most come naturally from the story and the 100% checklist — check Progress > Activities to see which you have done, and filter the map for Activities (blue dumbbell icon) for the rest.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the 12 ranges. The golds are not very hard, and you only need the golds — no other Shooting Range requirement. PowerPyx maps all 12 range locations.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every one of the 14 locations (42 races in total). You only need one win per location, not all 42 races.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. There are 40 unique race locations, so any 20 wins count, and race wins also feed the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui (Meet Cal), Cal texts you a fishing location (purple map icon). Follow his fishing questline and beat him in a fishing challenge.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish any one of the 4 arcade games (called Video Games in-game): Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III or Time Jackers Rewind, playable on the TV at home from Chapter 1, or Bang For Your Buck at arcade machines around the world. Finish all levels once — you do not need to beat every challenge. Pick whichever game you like best.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Lucia only. In Chapter 3 Andy calls and texts her home address in Belville. Finish her 5 quests: Climbing the Cellerichain (Parts 1–3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach! (the Cellerica initiation), Read the Label (retrieve the Cellerica van) and Puff Puff Pass (meet at the warehouse). All still available after the story.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's questline starts in Chapter 1 (after Island Dreams). He marks treasure chests on the map — dive for them with the metal detector and bring them back. Clear 7 shipwrecks in total. Kenton goes away for a while after Chapter 1 but returns in Chapters 2–3 (call Brian as Jason to speed it up). Track it in Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees and Progress > Collections > Kenton's Treasures.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's questline starts after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, at Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Finish his 5 quests: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler (steal the Impaler) and Hometown Heroes. All still available after the story.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 mission strands for strangers. Only certain questlines count — Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do NOT count. Confirmed counters: Kirk (Skunk Ape quests), Kyle (McKittrick Farm), Yago (street races) and Pilot Pete (deliveries), plus more still being found. All available after the story; watch the count in the trophy list.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's questline starts after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso and unlock the Key Cloner. He then wants 16 sports cars delivered — his wish list, tracked under Map > Robberies > Randy's Wish List. Scan cars with the WAiNK app to check them against the list, then drive each one back to his garage in west Vice City. Delivering in good condition pays more.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Jason only. After the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty, purple markers appear for Synthetic Labs in Vice City — go destroy them (the quest Take Out Kitty Litter). After enough labs, Tyrone gives the second quest, Spin On This, which unlocks the trophy. Still available after the story.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across 10 locations (track them in Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations). You can meditate as Jason and Lucia at each spot for +2. THE ONE MISSABLE TROPHY: during Chapter 1, after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning — she walks out to the balcony to meditate. Follow her and choose Accept. That balcony meditation vanishes after Chapter 1, and it is not yet confirmed whether it counts toward the trophy, so do it and keep a Chapter 1 save. For the 100% checklist you only need 15 of 18 meditations.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Jason only. After the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, Bret Vogel texts you and marks his first quest, Veteran Hunted, in Lummox County. Hunt the animals he requests and bring them to him. He gives you the unique rifle Killtelligence SM-69 in the first quest (retrieve it from any weapon locker at an Ammu-Nation). Track the 15 Target Decks under Map > Activities > Target Deck — you need all 15 for 100% anyway.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. There are 18 card set locations in total; PowerPyx maps them all.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan 100 WAiNK locations with the phone app (hold Up, then R1 to scan). Any 100 count — there are 31 Landmarks, 35 Curiosities, 23 Sculptures and No Flusher Tags, more than 100 in total.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges. For 100% you need 70, so this pops on the way — there are 10 more than needed, so pick the easiest. Track them under Progress > Challenges. Most complete naturally while doing other trophies; save the quickest ones for last.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break you can free-roam with your partner (hold Right + Triangle to call them). Get a 4-star wanted level, then escape the red heat zone. Easiest: drive through the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County — the cops and the helicopter struggle to follow on the tracks. It also pops automatically during the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is…, since bank vault robberies always trigger 4 stars.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: After Coffee Break, with your partner beside you, rob 3 shops back-to-back while staying wanted — keep the flashing wanted level, not the red heat level. Wear armor and carry sticky bombs and healing (Zombix or Adrenaline). A good spot is the 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City (after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3). Rob a couple of items in each store and break the safe with sticky bombs. The trophy pops about 30 seconds after leaving the 3rd shop — if it does not, hit a 4th.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Use the WAiNK app (hold Up, then R1) and scan vehicles as they pass — you do not need to drive them. There are 557 vehicles at launch. You need 200 of 277 base models scanned for 100%, so this pops on the way. Track it in Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus (L3 + R3 while aiming — it slows time and highlights weak spots). Buff your focus first with food, drinks or Adrenaline, wear body armor, and use an accurate full-auto rifle like the Duke 556. Gang Operations are the best spot — the trophy does not seem to count soldiers, police or civilians. Focus has 4 levels (raised by shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots), so it gets easier late in the game.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane docked at a departure terminal at VCIA (Vice City International Airport) — it must be one connected to a boarding bridge, not one on the airfield. Easiest is the plane at terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence, climb the stairs by the boarding bridge, enter the plane, go upstairs to the cockpit, reverse to the airstrip and take off. Fly 1 km away from the airport and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank at Mile Zero Air Station, the island on the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County. The tanks stand in the south of the base — drive through the gate (or take the stunt jump by the south-east entrance), climb in and shoot enemies until it pops.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs — it unlocks the Snap Gun and jewelry store robberies (green map icons). Break in through a back door with the Snap Gun (never kick the door — that trips the alarm), find the safe code note, loot the safe, destroy the security footage and disable the alarm in the back room. Leave and it pops shortly after. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good one.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (tail a security van to a bank, slip in while the vault is open, bring your partner to hand off a bag), pay Yasmani $10,000 for security van tips — he marks the vans purple. Rob any 5 of the 8 Large Bank Jobs and escape; you need all 8 for 100%, so it pops on the way. Each vault pays up to $205,000, and every robbery triggers a 4-star wanted level — escape on a fast motorcycle, then switch cars to break the heat.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. It pops automatically in the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (robbing a bank vault counts). Earlier method: block an armored truck near a bank, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it — then escape the red heat radius. Sticky bombs sit in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Unfog the whole map of Leonida. The fastest way is by plane — fly over every black-fogged area until the map is fully visible.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 operations in total (yellow map icons when you are near them) — you need all 39 for 100%, so this pops on the way. Track each gang's count in Progress > Gangs.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach and buy an Apple Martini. Drink it while standing next to the bar.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Steal the blue Banshee from the vehicle showroom in south Vice City and drive it straight through the showroom window. You need the Key Cloner first (Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs). It only works with that blue Banshee — a nod to the Banshee from GTA III. The trophy pops a moment after you drive away.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Rob Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn (a Gang Operation — it appears during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling). Steal all 3 key valuables: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique shotgun Gutterball Moreland 850 on the table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway office (blow it with sticky bombs — buy them at an Ammu-Nation first). The trophy pops after you escape the police. You do not need all 3 in one visit — the robbery icon respawns, so you can come back for the rest.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reach maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time (check Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Strength). Only possible after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can switch between them. Work out together at a fitness club — bring your partner (hold Right + Triangle) and while one trains, the other completes their training automatically, so you progress twice as fast. You can also work out at home after the story.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile. Turn the notifications on (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile = On) and watch for the demon face icon. The profile runs Professional (stealthy, clean escapes) to Hardened to Violent to Psycho to Irredeemable — the last is permanent, so avoid it: cops get far more aggressive. It comes naturally from robberies and fights; if you are short at the end, it can be farmed quickly, but mind the Irredeemable risk.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: No confirmed method yet at launch — PowerPyx lists this trophy as unknown, believed to be tied to the Payday Loans store from the prologue. Treat it as unconfirmed and check back as players pin it down.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Complete the UFO easter egg. Go solo, at night after 2 AM, to the road north-west of Starlet Motel in Kelly County. Sometimes a blinking car is parked at the roadside — if it is not there, drive away and come back. Follow the path into the woods from the car and you will see the UFO (a bright blue light in the sky). Approach it: it drops a woman it abducted. Talk to her, offer to help, and go back to her car at the roadside.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: No confirmed method yet at launch — PowerPyx lists this trophy as unknown, believed to be from kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle. Treat it as unconfirmed and check back as players pin it down.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew) to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer. Then rob banks and Payday Loans and bring the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The $250,000 is cumulative across robberies. Bank vaults pay up to $205,000 in one robbery, but they only unlock after the Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is….

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Guns, car mods and tattoos are the fastest — they are the most expensive. There are 24 Ammu-Nations, 14 mod shops, 67 clothing stores, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 17 footwear stores, 18 hair & beauty salons, 11 tattoo studios and 15 electronics stores.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages (the 4 story garages do not count). They cost $160,000 in total. Garages go on sale after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver (Steal the Crawler for Moses) — the Vice City Real Estate app appears on your phone, and you buy through it. Robberies, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3–4, are the fastest way to earn the money.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. The app arrives after the Chapter 2 mission Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses). Buy garages first (see Little Boxes) — each garage adds parking spots. Drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn, choose Respray then Register. At first he only takes vehicles without trackers; from Chapter 3 you can also register cars with Standard Trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registering costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes.
